title: BUGFIX — Fix stale published<=qc_passed assertion in Block F Orchestrator validation
rationale: validate-orchestrator.ts (Block F integration test) had the same stale assert(s.published <= s.qc_passed) assertion as Sprint 1430 fixed in validate-flywheel-output.ts. After Blotato multi-platform was added, published = qc_passed × 9 platforms, so the old upper-bound assertion always fails. Fixed: replaced with published >= qc_passed (at least 1 platform per video) and published <= qc_passed×9 (max 9 Blotato platforms). Same pattern as Sprint 1430.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/validate-orchestrator.ts line 76: replace assert(s.published <= s.qc_passed) with two assertions: (1) s.published >= s.qc_passed (each QC-passed video published to at least 1 platform), (2) s.published <= s.qc_passed * 9 (max 9 Blotato platforms). Added comment explaining Blotato multi-platform rationale.
